# Aureon

> Aureon is an uncensored AI intelligence platform: truth-telling chat, OSINT search, elite coding engine, predictive analytics, and end-to-end encrypted intelligence tooling.

Aureon ships a suite of intelligence modules — Zophiel OSINT search, NOMAD investigation, ZALI engineering simulation, ZERLAL vulnerability scanning, Cross screen-intelligence, Vedic analysis, predictive forecasting, and an in-dashboard IDE. Bring-your-own-key (BYOK) is supported across all AI modules.
